decisions.statement: A file reaching `vscode` states no import.
The names are declared in one ambient module block.
Every name the editor hands an extension is declared here.
This declaration restates the editor fork's own `src/vscode-dts/vscode.d.ts`.
A promote of the fork refuses while this declaration differs from the fork's copy.
A copy behind the fork typechecks clean and throws at load.
Nothing here is written by hand.

definition: the editor api an extension in this tree compiles against
